newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Kaikai plans cash dividend for 1995.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Kaikai plans cash dividend for 1995.

text.p: Clothing maker Shanghai Kaikai Industrial Co Ltd said on Wednesday it plans to pay a 1995 cash dividend of 0.10 yuan per share for shareholders registered at the end of 1995.
In a statement, the company said it would pay a total cash dividend of 9.21 million yuan.
The plan has been approved by a shareholders' meeting, it said but gave no further details.
The company reported net profits of 36 million yuan ($4.34 million) in 1995 and Kaikai's chairman Jiang Yusen has said it would easily beat the 1996 profit target of 60 million yuan. ($1 = 8.3 yuan)
